tools.name: Hourly rate
tools.desc: Start from the take-home pay you want. This works backwards through tax, expenses and time off.

tools.name: Project quote
tools.desc: Estimate the hours, add a buffer for surprises, and see what the quote really pays you per hour.

tools.name: Invoice
tools.desc: Fill in the details, watch the invoice update, then print or save it as a PDF. No account needed.

tools.name: Markup & margin
tools.desc: Enter your cost and one other number. You get the selling price, profit, markup and margin.

tools.name: Retainer
tools.desc: Compare a fixed monthly fee with billing by the hour, including what happens when the client uses more or fewer hours than planned.

tools.name: Late fee
tools.desc: Add interest and a flat fee to an overdue invoice and see the total you can ask for.

tools.name: Tax
tools.desc: Estimate the tax and social contributions on your freelance profit, and how much to set aside each quarter.

tools.name: PPP pricing
tools.desc: Enter your US price and see a fair price for each country, based on what money buys there.
